cases.name: extra-final-newline.note
cases.says: a second `0x0A` after the final signature creates a forbidden blank line

cases.name: untrusted-log-key.note
cases.says: The note MUST verify under the anchored log key

cases.name: wrong-origin.note
cases.says: The origin line MUST equal the anchored origin

cases.name: bad-leaf-hash.note
cases.says: The leaf hash MUST be standard base64 and decode to exactly 32 bytes

cases.name: leaf-hash-nonzero-pad-bits.note
cases.says: unused pad bits in the leaf hash MUST be zero

cases.name: leading-zero.note
cases.says: The deadline MUST be canonical decimal

cases.name: different-entry.note
cases.says: the submitted entry's leaf hash MUST equal the receipt's leaf hash

cases.name: expired-at-deadline.note
cases.says: A nonzero checking time at or after the deadline MUST refuse the receipt
